notes.title: The release day is set to 25th March
notes.content:
Plaguepunk Justice, an unusual tactical healing game, will be released on 25th March. 
Previous release was set to 25th February but it is quite clear that even if the game would be completely done by this date, it would not let allow time to work on its marketing. 
Meanwhile the development continues.
